about: Each posting site's own pricing levers and the signals it gives a seller, as of 2026-11-15. Marks: observed (read on the page), asserted (third party, snippet or memory), inferred (our reasoning). The reading of each row is in ../levers-and-signals.md. `rules` feed defaults.mjs and are agent proposals.

stages.exposure: shown in a search or feed
stages.interest: kept it: like, save, watch, bag
stages.intent: acted toward buying: offer, message, cart

rules.strikethrough_why: 16 CFR 233.1: a former price shown must have been openly offered for a reasonably substantial period; 7 days is our starting value

markdown.tool: revise the price; sale events and strikethrough need an eBay Store

keep_off.why: sends one fixed discount forever; our offers follow the plan

levers.name: Best Offer auto-accept and auto-decline
levers.where: listing form, Seller Hub; Trading and Inventory APIs
levers.params: accept line must be under Buy It Now; offers between the lines wait for the seller; no auto-counter; not during a Discounts Manager sale event or on offers with extra terms
levers.notifies: auto-declined buyers get an email and may offer again, 3 offers per buyer per item

levers.name: Buyer offer
levers.params: lasts 24 h or until the listing ends; counteroffers last 96 h, up to 5 each side; accepting ends the listing and in most cases the buyer must pay at once

levers.name: Send offers to interested buyers
levers.where: Seller Hub; Negotiation API findEligibleItems and sendOfferToInterestedBuyers
levers.params: at least 5% off; the 30 most recent watchers or buyers with it in their cart for 2 days or more; valid 96 h; eBay's automated mode sends up to 30 every 48 h; API offers cannot allow counters and use the default duration
levers.visibility: private; the public price is unchanged
levers.source: help id=4144; developer.ebay.com Negotiation API overview (undated)

levers.name: Lower the price
levers.params: any amount
levers.notifies: watchers: not confirmed (community posts say yes)

levers.name: Sale event or markdown with a struck-through price
levers.where: Seller Hub Marketing > Discounts Manager; Marketing API item_price_markdown
levers.params: eBay Store subscribers only; fixed price only; percent or amount off; values cannot change after launch; auto-accept and auto-decline stop during it
levers.visibility: sale price shown in search and on the listing

levers.name: Volume pricing, coupons, order discounts
levers.params: Store only; an accepted offer wins over a coupon

levers.name: Promoted Listings General (cost per sale)
levers.params: ad rate from 2%; fee if the buyer clicked the ad in the last 30 days
levers.visibility: placed inside the same ranker with the rate as an input

signals.name: Search impressions
signals.definition: times shown on search results (LISTING_IMPRESSION_SEARCH_RESULTS_PAGE); may not have been in view
signals.read: Sell Analytics getTrafficReport, dimension LISTING, up to 200 listings and 90 days per call, 730 days back

signals.name: All impressions
signals.definition: TOTAL_IMPRESSION_TOTAL, every page and flow; matches Seller Hub

signals.name: Listing views
signals.definition: View Item page visits; split by source: search, store, other eBay, off eBay, direct (LISTING_VIEWS_*)

signals.name: Click-through rate
signals.definition: clicks over search impressions (the doc's wording is inverted)

signals.name: Sales conversion rate
signals.definition: transactions over views

signals.name: Top 20 search slot and promoted or organic split
signals.definition: share of impressions in the first 20 results; promoted versus organic views
signals.where: Seller Hub listing traffic report and its CSV only since Nov 2024

signals.name: Watchers
signals.definition: buyers who added it to their watchlist
signals.scope: seller count; buyers see a watcher label
signals.read: Trading GetMyeBaySelling WatchCount (asserted); Browse watchCount needs App Check

signals.name: In carts
signals.definition: buyers with it in their cart; feeds 'interested buyers' after 2 days
signals.source: community thread titles; help id=4144 for the 2-day rule (observed)

signals.name: Offers received
signals.definition: Best Offers with amount

markdown.tool: discount_price (struck-through original, tag on the photo, icon in search)

levers.name: Buyer offer (Make Offer)
levers.where: buyer side; seller answers in Inbox > Offers
levers.params: seller has 24 h; after acceptance the buyer has 24 h to pay; one active offer per buyer per item; not binding; seller can accept several, first to pay wins
levers.notifies: seller; on acceptance all accepted buyers

levers.name: Send offer to likers, bag-adders and people who messaged
levers.params: at least 5% under the price; expiry 24 h in the API docs, 14 days on the help page read 2026-11-14 (unresolved)

levers.name: Auto-send offers to new likers and bag-adders
levers.params: sent one hour after a like or bag, delay fixed; at least 5% under the price or the discount price

levers.name: Auto-respond to offers
levers.where: app: Manage your listing > Auto-respond; API auto_negotiate_offer_price
levers.params: at or above the line: accepted; below: countered at exactly the line, every time; within about 60 s; at least 5% under the price

levers.name: Discount
levers.params: 5% to 95%; a new discount replaces the old
levers.notifies: price-drop notice to likers not found
levers.visibility: original price crossed out, tag on the photo, icon in search results

levers.name: Shipping discount
levers.params: $2, $3, $4 off or free

levers.name: Bundle discount
levers.params: percent off 2 or more items

levers.name: Boost a listing or the whole shop
levers.params: 12% fee only if the buyer saw the boosted tile and bought within 28 days
levers.visibility: an extra placement labelled boosted; the organic listing stays

signals.name: Impressions and clicks, organic and boosted
signals.definition: ad performance for the product: organic and boosted clicks and impressions
signals.source: partner API changelog Jul 2026; field names not seen

signals.name: Views
signals.definition: Shop Stats in the app and Selling Hub
signals.read: harness only; no views field in the API

signals.name: Likes
signals.definition: users who liked the listing
signals.read: insights likes_count; webhooks v1:product.like and unlike; public webapi like_count
signals.latency: webhook near live; insights up to 60 min

signals.name: Bag adds
signals.definition: users with the product in their bag now

signals.name: Pending offers
signals.definition: offers awaiting seller or buyer review
signals.read: insights offers section; no list-offers endpoint

signals.name: Sales and earnings
signals.definition: orders with fees
signals.read: orders API and webhooks; CSV up to 3 months per file

rules.note: Smart Sell may still counter an offer above its minimum, aiming for the list price; it is a test, not on every account

markdown.why: a drop of 10% or more below the lowest-ever price, ending at $10 or more, notifies likers

keep_off.why: pay per click; spending asks first

levers.name: Buyer offer
levers.params: expires in 24 h; binding, payment taken on acceptance; first accepted wins; minimum offer about 40% of list (asserted)
levers.source: blog.poshmark.com 2014-10-09 FAQ; 2026-06-16 offer test post; minimum from valueaddedresource 2025-09-14

levers.name: Offer to Likers
levers.params: at least 10% off and 10% below the lowest offer in 90 days; shipping discount none, $4.99 or free; expires in 24 h

levers.name: Price drop
levers.params: likers notified when the drop is 10% or more below the lowest-ever price and the new price is $10 or more; some drops get a random 6-hour shipping promotion

levers.name: Smart Sell
levers.where: share page toggle; testing in the listing flow
levers.params: one minimum; below it counters; at or above an algorithm accepts or counters toward list
levers.visibility: Poshmark claims 60% more likely to sell in 7 days
levers.source: blog.poshmark.com/smart-sell (modified 2025-08-20: not yet for all); 2026-04-29, 2026-07-30 posts

levers.name: Closet Clear Out
levers.params: drop of 10% or more; Poshmark pays discounted shipping

levers.name: Bundle discount
levers.params: percent off and a minimum item count

levers.name: Promoted Closet
levers.params: pay per click, weekly budget

levers.name: Inactive listings
levers.params: no bundling, commenting, offering or editing for 60 days
levers.visibility: active listings are prioritized in search and browsing

signals.name: Impressions
signals.definition: not defined by Poshmark
signals.read: harness only; no API or export

signals.name: Clicks
signals.definition: not defined

signals.name: Likes
signals.definition: shoppers who liked it; the audience for Offer to Likers and price-drop notices

signals.name: Seller offers and buyer offers
signals.definition: counts on the listing

signals.name: Posh Stats
signals.definition: ship time over 90 days, cancellations, approved returns, sales

markdown.tool: Promote: a permanent drop of 5% or more under the lowest price so far, once a day
markdown.why: Promote notifies every liker and boosts the listing in search

keep_off.why: its drops lower the lowest-price-so far that every later Promote or offer must undercut

levers.name: Buyer offer
levers.params: 24 h each way; accepting a counter charges the buyer

levers.name: Promote
levers.params: permanent drop of 5% or more under the lowest price so far; not under $1; once per 24 h per item

levers.name: Offer to Likers
levers.params: 10% or more under the lowest price so far; 50 newest likers; 24 h; binding; once per 72 h; the form pre-fills a larger discount (asserted)

levers.name: Auto Offer to Likers
levers.params: sends your latest offer to each new liker after the delay you pick; only below the item price

levers.name: Time-limited Sale
levers.params: listed 7 days or more; 10% or more under the lowest price so far; 3 days, then the price returns
levers.visibility: search boost and the Deals section

levers.name: Smart Pricing
levers.params: start and floor; lowered gradually on demand; cadence not stated

signals.name: Item views
signals.definition: times the item was shown across search and buyer feeds: an impression count, not page views

signals.name: Item clicks
signals.definition: times shoppers opened the item

signals.name: Likes
signals.definition: buyers who liked it; the audience for Promote and Offer to Likers
signals.source: article 347 for the audience; count display not checked

signals.name: Offers
signals.definition: buyer offers with amount

signals.name: Gross Sales Report
signals.definition: per sale: price, fees, net, dates

markdown.tool: edit the price (savers may be told; no Meta source)

turn_on.why: Meta drafts it; the seller enables and edits it at listing

keep_off.why: billed whether or not it sells; spending asks first

levers.name: Offer in chat
levers.params: a typed number; nothing binds until the handover

levers.name: Lower the price
levers.params: any amount
levers.notifies: savers, by several third parties; unreliable per CarSnipe; no Meta source
levers.source: carsnipe.com 2026-02-18; crawlbench.com 2026-11-03; Meta ranking card 2026-09-30 for price as a signal (observed by Nate)

levers.name: Renew
levers.params: no published timing or limit

levers.name: Availability auto-reply
levers.params: Meta AI drafts from description, availability, pickup place and price; seller enables, previews, edits

levers.name: Boost (fixed budget or cost per sale)
levers.params: fixed budget billed on impressions; cost per sale 15 to 30% for shipped listings, 7-day click window
levers.visibility: an ad, outside the ranking AI

signals.name: Views and clicks
signals.definition: performance data like views, clicks, message threads and sold listings; per listing or total not stated
signals.where: Marketplace Seller app, Performance insights (iOS, US)

signals.name: Saves
signals.definition: people who saved the listing; how many times listings were saved

signals.name: Shares
signals.definition: times listings were shared to Feed, Messenger or WhatsApp

signals.name: Message threads
signals.definition: one Messenger thread per buyer
signals.source: Meta Seller app post 2026-07-24 names message threads

signals.name: Boost results
signals.definition: reach, link clicks, messaging conversations, cost per conversation
signals.read: Marketing API Ads Insights on the seller's ad account (inferred)
